content.page_summary: Clinical questions and recommended study designs related to management of patients with multivessel coronary artery disease and related acute coronary syndromes.
content.title: Management of patients with multivessel disease

Does intensive medical therapy improve outcomes in patients with MVD compared with standard secondary prevention?
contextual_questions_above_section: Does intracoronary hypothermia reduce infarct size and improve clinical outcomes in STEMI patients undergoing PPCI?
